desc: Read the input N and the sequence A from standard input.
Sort the sequence A in non-decreasing order.
Calculate the maximum total score by iterating from the start and end of the sorted array towards the center, summing the differences $A[N-1-i] - A[i]$ for $i$ from 0 up to $\lfloor (N-1)/2 \rfloor$.
Print the calculated sum to standard output.
Run the provided code against Sample 1, Sample 2, and Sample 3 to verify the output matches the expected results (5, 14, 0).
Confirm the solution handles edge cases (e.g., $N=2$, $N=3$, all elements equal).
